verdict.rationale: Wise's API reference covers most major business features—accounts, transfers, cards, statements, disputes, webhooks, batch payments, multi-currency balances—suggesting broad functional parity with the UI. However, there's no explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity, no OpenAPI spec discoverable (404s), and some UI-highlighted features (rate lock guarantees, FDIC insurance opt-in) aren't clearly mapped to specific API endpoints in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, discoverable OpenAPI spec, API coverage confirmation for rate-lock/insurance features, independent third-party verification of completeness.
